2 hours of website support every month (24 hours a year) are included on all three options. The billing choice changes how you pay, not how much support you receive.

Good to know. Included support hours apply to standard website updates and maintenance work. Larger development projects, redesigns, new functionality, third-party integrations or custom development are quoted separately. Any unused included hours expire at the end of each month and do not roll over.

Every price is a fixed, no-surprises quote confirmed before we start. All website package and Care Plan prices shown include GST.

What affects cost

What changes the price of a website.

Every project is quoted on scope. These are the main things that move the number up or down.

  • Number of pagesA one-page site and a twelve-page site take very different effort. Page count is the biggest driver of cost.
  • Design complexityA clean template-led build costs less than fully custom design and bespoke sections.
  • Features and functionalityOnline stores, bookings, member areas and integrations add build time.
  • Content and copyWhether you supply copy and images or we write and source them changes the scope.
  • Ongoing careHosting, security and care plans are optional and priced separately from the build.
  • SEO scopeThe core SEO build is included. Deeper ongoing SEO campaigns are a separate service.
Included free

The SEO build is on every package.

Every website ships with an SEO build set up for you, so you are ready to be found from day one.

  • SEO-optimised contentPages written to match what your customers search for.
  • Schema markup on every pageStructured data so Google and AI engines understand your business.
  • Technical SEO setupSpeed, mobile, indexing and a clean structure from launch.
  • Search Console and AnalyticsConnected and configured so you can see your results.
Common questions

Pricing questions, answered.

How much does a website cost in Australia?

It depends on scope. A simple business site costs less than a large custom or eCommerce build. Rather than a one-size price, we give you a fixed, itemised quote after a short discovery chat, so the number reflects exactly what you need.

What is included in the price?

Every package includes the design and build plus a complete SEO build, covering optimised content, schema markup, technical setup and Search Console and Analytics. Hosting and care plans are optional and priced separately.

Is the quote fixed or an estimate?

Fixed. Once we agree the scope, your written quote is the price. If you later add work, we quote that separately before starting, so you are never surprised by an invoice.

Do you offer payment plans?

We can structure staged payments across the project on request. Ask us during your quote and we will set out the options.
